current.label: 新版 · 服务95%–95.5%、全60期最终拟合

reset_holdout.interpretation: disjoint retrospective training episode; not chronological future performance

parameters.selection_rule: 28-day held-out training reset service in [.95,.955]; min inventory/demand, then candidate id; three forward folds are prefix diagnostics
parameters.final_risk_rule: max full60 and four training-slice risk waterlines; dynamic common scalar lambda chosen causally from remaining service budget and empirical response CDF
parameters.response_rule: 128 midpoint quantiles per group; prior/(prior+observed periods), latest window one-step residuals; episode first demand never counted as one-step error
parameters.test_initialization: original initial inventory, zero pipeline, Period_1 restart; all28 periods scored
parameters.audit_note: Same test file has been evaluated in prior model revisions. Feedback uses only already realized demand, never future demand. Narrow-band guarantee is empirical, not for arbitrary unbounded future demand.

historical.label: 历史版 · 需求满足率约束

parameters.inventory_rule: after demand t, order; receive before demand t+1
parameters.objective: minimize sum of period-ending inventory / sum of demand
parameters.ambiguity: rectangular W-infinity balls around nonnegative relative residual samples
parameters.selection: training-only forward and early-reset blocked validation
parameters.ro_calibration: training only; width grid 0:0.025:8 then local 0.001 refinement; original selection rules
